evals.name: clean-commit-passes-all-checks
evals.prompt: I've staged my changes to src/gui_unified.py and tests/test_gui_unified.py. commit this with message 'fix(gui): correct voice dropdown rebuild on language change'
evals.expected_output: Assistant runs git status and git diff --cached to confirm staged scope. Reads TODO.md in full; finds no In Progress items that claim gui_unified.py. Invokes copyright-scan skill over the staged diff; it passes. Greps the staged diff and the draft commit subject for forbidden strings (Claude, Anthropic, Co-Authored-By, etc.); none found. Validates subject 'fix(gui): correct voice dropdown rebuild on language change' — allowed type, lowercase, present-tense imperative, no trailing period, under 72 chars. All checks pass. Runs git commit with the validated message via a HEREDOC, without --amend or --no-verify.

evals.name: ai-mention-in-diff-blocks-commit
evals.prompt: stage and commit src/synthesis_orchestrator.py — I added a docstring explaining how the AI agent routes jobs
evals.expected_output: Assistant runs git status and git diff --cached. Reads TODO.md. Invokes copyright-scan; assume pass. Greps the staged diff for forbidden strings and finds 'AI agent' in the new docstring. Surfaces the exact file and line to the user. Stops — does not proceed to git commit. Tells the user the string must be removed or reworded (e.g. 'how the orchestrator routes jobs') before the commit can proceed. Does not auto-edit the file without user confirmation.

evals.name: bad-subject-type-blocked-and-fixed
evals.prompt: commit the staged settings frame changes with message 'gui: add dark mode toggle'
evals.expected_output: Assistant runs git status and git diff --cached. Reads TODO.md. Invokes copyright-scan; assume pass. Greps diff and draft message for forbidden strings; none found. Validates the subject 'gui: add dark mode toggle' — fails because 'gui' is not an allowed type (it is a bare scope without a type prefix). Assistant explains the correct form, proposes 'feat(gui): add dark mode toggle' or 'fix(gui): add dark mode toggle' depending on context, and asks the user to confirm which type is right before committing. Does not commit the malformed subject.
